arguments.value: User reports Ubuntu 20.04.6 desktop became very slow immediately after apt update/upgrade that pulled in Ubuntu Pro-related packages. Hardware is high-end (i7-10700K, 32GB RAM, NVMe SSD, RTX 3070), so likely not a resource issue. top shows a node-related process chain consuming significant CPU; node software hasn’t been updated in about a year. Browser use also causes CPU spikes. free -h shows plenty of memory available. Suspects the recent system update/upgrade caused the slowdown.
